name: Fujimaru Rie
source:
Rie is a nurse in the Umegaoka Memorial General Hospital. She is an earnest, gentle and hardworking nurse without ambitions. Rie is in charge of taking care of Fuyuka. 
Lately she had been hearing some strange stories from her colleagues about what is going on in the hospital.

Special Skills: Handicraft, [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electone]Electone[/url] (?)
Dreams for the future: wants to have three children, the eldest will be a girl, the second...~and so on and so forth~

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
